# Shruti 1.4.40
- Updates no longer wait forever because a saved volume, mute or effect control is attached to a silent app. - A browser keeping its audio stream open does not block an update when Shruti’s healthy audio tap confirms it is silent. This uses the signal before Shruti’s mute and volume controls, so muted playback remains protected. - Active recording, real playback, missing activity information and stale audio measurements still hold the update. After 10 seconds of confirmed quiet, an update you already chose can continue. - If an update is waiting, Shruti names the app holding it or says it is waiting for the quiet interval.
Requires macOS 14.2 or later; Apple silicon and Intel. Existing settings, app arrangements and window preferences are retained.
